verdict.rationale: A probe confirms LegalZoom serves an llms.txt at https://www.legalzoom.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), headed "LegalZoom LLMs.txt — Guidance for AI Craw[lers]", so an agent can be pointed at a first-party, AI-oriented entry point. The snippet is truncated and framed as crawler guidance, so it is unclear how much substantive agent-usable documentation it contains. Missing for 10: evidence of what the llms.txt actually contains (content depth, links to product and service docs), any broader agent-oriented docs beyond the single file, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
